answer: Count an identity's vote and reward only after a streak of 20 consecutive peer-accepted answers; one missed or rejected epoch halves the streak. Standing builds like a glacier, slow and only by showing up, so a 200-clone farm must push 4,000 original graded answers through peers before earning a single token, and every lazy quill risks a halving. Seen through that prism, faking is just honest work times 200 (20-epoch gate and halving rule are my assumed parameters).
